notes: ILMEA runs a two-stage process: students audition at the district level (9 districts, each with its own audition dates and its own district-selected piece), and top district scorers are selected for the All-State ensembles that rehearse and perform at the Illinois Music Education Conference (IMEC). The 2026-2027 statewide audition selections and audition requirements are explicitly posted for the 2026-27 school year (IMEC 2027). The performance repertoire and guest conductors currently listed on ILMEA's All-State Chorus Information page are for IMEC 2026 (the 2025-26 season), so they were deliberately NOT recorded here as 2026-27 data. District-level audition dates are published per-district and vary; they were not aggregated.

organization.name: Illinois Music Education Association
organization.description: ILMEA is the statewide music educators association for Illinois. It administers district-level auditions in nine districts and selects students for All-State ensembles that perform at the Illinois Music Education Conference (IMEC).

programs.name: ILMEA All-State Chorus (Senior Level)
programs.description: Senior-level All-State mixed chorus selected from district auditions and performing at the Illinois Music Education Conference (IMEC).

dates.title: Illinois Music Education Conference (IMEC) 2027
dates.description: ILMEA's published IMEC dates: Wednesday, January 27 - Saturday, January 30, 2027. All-State ensembles rehearse and perform during the conference.

requirements.title: Senior level audition — 100 points total
requirements.description: The senior chorus audition is a performance test totaling 100 points: two statewide prepared selections (28 points each), one district-selected piece (28 points), and tonal skills (16 points). Tie-breaker categories, in order, are Tone, Musicianship, Intonation.

requirements.title: Senior tonal skills — triads and scales
requirements.description: Sing the Major triad on E; sing two of the other three root-position triads (minor, diminished, augmented) selected by the Chorus Division President (F and D suggested as root tones); sing one major scale and one minor scale — Soprano/Tenor sing F Major and d minor, Alto/Bass sing Db Major and bb minor. The minor form (natural, harmonic, or melodic) is selected annually by the Chorus Division President and is consistent statewide, though students are responsible for all three forms. Scales are sung one octave up and down with the top note sung only once. Numbers, solfeggio, or a neutral syllable may be used; humming is not allowed.

requirements.title: Video-recorded audition
requirements.description: ILMEA publishes audition video recording and sharing instructions in separate student and educator editions.

repertoire.title: Beati quorum via
repertoire.notes: One of two 2026-2027 statewide senior chorus audition selections.

repertoire.title: Alleluia
repertoire.notes: One of two 2026-2027 statewide senior chorus audition selections.

programs.name: ILMEA Honors Chorus (Senior Level)
programs.description: Second senior-level statewide honor chorus selected through the same district audition process as the All-State Chorus and performing at IMEC.

requirements.title: Senior level audition — 100 points total
requirements.description: Selection uses the same senior-level chorus audition as the All-State Chorus: two statewide prepared selections (28 points each), one district selection (28 points), and tonal skills (16 points).

programs.name: ILMEA Junior High Chorus (Junior Level)
programs.description: Junior-level All-State chorus for junior high students, selected through district auditions and performing at IMEC.

requirements.title: Junior level audition — 50 points total
requirements.description: The junior chorus audition is a performance test totaling 50 points: two prepared selections (20 points each, 40 total) — one statewide selection chosen by the Chorus Division President and one district selection chosen by the District Junior Chorus Representative — plus triads (3 points each, 6 total) and one major scale (4 points).

requirements.title: Junior triads and scale starting pitches
requirements.description: Students sing one Major triad and one Minor triad unaccompanied, ascending and descending, from a given pitch, and one Major scale unaccompanied, ascending and descending, from a given pitch. Sopranos start from the F above middle C; Altos from the D-flat above middle C; Baritones from a pitch of their choice, which must be played audibly on the video audition before being sung.

repertoire.title: The Old Mill
repertoire.notes: Statewide Junior Chorus audition selection for the 2026-2027 school year (IMEC 2027). Each junior audition also includes a district-selected piece.
